text: Color scan copies of the passport (including the photo page and the visa page) Photographs taken within the last 6 months (no headwear, frontal vertical format, 1-inch ID photo, JPG or JPEG format, not exceeding 1MB) Color scanned copy of the undergraduate graduation certificate (Fresh graduates can provide a pre-graduation certificate first) Color scanned copies of all course transcripts from the undergraduate period Color scanned copy of the official score report from the Chinese/English proficiency test (original certificate must be provided during registration for verification) Guide's Acceptance Letter from Jiangnan University (see the attached file below) Research Plan Two recommendation letters Economic guarantee certificate (see the attached document below) Deposit certificate (bank transaction record proof within the past 6 months) Certificate of No Criminal Record Physical examination report (within 6 months) (see the attached file below) To apply for the design major, at least 3 pieces of work must be submitted.
